trackDescription: Focuses on Slalom’s business by delivering capabilities and offerings to customers, and supports business growth through excellent delivery. Leaders in this track are accountable for ensuring the successful delivery of team projects and cultivating talent within their teams.
jobTitleSummary: Optimizes performance through independent delivery, innovative solutioning, and knowledge sharing. Deepens technical/functional expertise and strengthens internal and external relationships.

Deliver Exceptionally.expectation: Proactively contributes to delivery, partnering with teams and clients to meet and exceed delivery commitments.
Organizes and prioritizes work effectively, balancing multiple tasks while meeting deadlines with minimal oversight.
Optimizes personal velocity and sets an example in consistency for teammates.
Anticipates and addresses delivery issues/risks, escalating appropriately to leadership.
Uses knowledge, guidance, and examples to build solutions.
Learns and applies quality standards.
Explores ways to be more innovative in day-to-day work.
Learns about solution impact and outcomes.
Applies critical thinking to evaluate information, challenge assumptions, and make informed decisions.
Leverages emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes.

Delivers audience-tailored, high-quality written and visual communications, role modeling effective practices in ensuring audience engagement and clarity, and using communications to align stakeholders.
Communicates effectively with the team and external stakeholders, ensuring mutual understanding.
Articulates project scope, goals, plans, and status to clients and stakeholders.
Builds and expands authentic relationships with clients by using active listening strategies.
Addresses client concerns promptly and responds non-defensively, seeking support as needed.
Begins to independently link project deliverables to the client’s short-term objectives.
Explains the purpose and benefit of own work to colleagues and, with guidance, to clients.
Asks clarifying questions to better understand client concerns.
Contributes in client meetings by sharing updates in a concise manner.
Identifies early indicators (e.g., quick wins) that show how individual contributions create measurable benefits.
References initial client feedback or positive outcomes to illustrate value.
Learns and embraces various cultures within the client organization by being flexible and adjusting to varying client settings.
Applies active listening and thoughtful communication techniques to understand audience needs, influence discussions, and encourage clear decision-making within the team.
Onboards efficiently to new projects and immediately starts contributing to delivery and project success.

Grow Expertise.expectation: Deepens and/or broadens in Functional/Technical roles (e.g., Proficient+ in 1+).
Proactively seeks learning and growth opportunities, demonstrating a spirit and application of continuous growth, learning, and goal setting.
Seeks opportunities to share content and knowledge with fellow team members (e.g., lunch and learns).
Provides support to team members who seek out mentorship through their work.
Learns about knowledge management practices, reviewing and/or contributing to knowledge management.
May contribute to Slalom solutioning (e.g., perspectives, offerings, accelerators) for a capability, industry, or customer outcome, if requested and prioritized.
Shows an emerging interest in new technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents), following team guidance to explore related resources.
Builds and exhibits expertise of client's business and industry on engagements.

Grow Slalom.expectation: Maintains client relationships and begins developing external professional network.
Is a steward of the Slalom brand (e.g., culture, core values, strategic initiatives, solutions, impact, the value Slalom offers to clients), actively promoting it outside the organization.
Deepens and broadens connections across Slalom, on projects and across capability, geography, outcome and industry teams.
Shapes Slalom culture by demonstrating core values and actively engaging in Slalom events and initiatives (e.g., employee resource groups, hackathons).
Proactively maximizes staffability by regularly updating profile, initiating staffing conversations, and engaging in meaningful bench activity (e.g., skill development, solutioning).
Enters time and expenses accurately and on time; plans and seeks approval for time off.
Able to deliver a basic elevator pitch for Slalom’s services and share one client example from their capability area to illustrate impact.
Learns about Slalom-wide financial metrics and foundational business operational knowledge.

Demonstrates basic understanding of Slalom business (e.g., capabilities, clients, industries, solutions) and strategy (e.g., how Slalom goes to market, value proposition, strategic priorities and initiatives).
Begins to identify opportunities to bring more value to the client in delivery environments; sharing with project / account leads.

Lead.expectation: Improves personal energy and attention management practices (e.g., prioritizes workload effectively, independently manages tasks and adjusts to changing demands).
Identifies and acts on growth opportunities identified via development and career goals, self-reflection, feedback, and performance processes.
Seeks to understand the impact of own behavior on others.
Attentively listens, working to incorporate others' points of view and minimize self-orientation.
Engages in structured and respectful conflict resolution, balancing multiple viewpoints in team and client interactions.
Regularly gives and receives feedback with an open mind, curiosity, and respect - and actions on it.
Consistently demonstrates flexibility with changing priorities, staying open to new ways of working.
Communicates openly with team or stakeholders when navigating change.
Understands how work contributes to internal team vision and strategy.
Uses the Situation-Behavior-Impact (SBI) framework to structure their feedback and give timely, specific feedback, both positive and constructive.
Capable of navigating moderate and high levels of ambiguity with appropriate oversight and direction, functioning independently under low levels of ambiguity.
Seeks to collaborate where appropriate to deliver outcomes more effectively and efficiently.
